long_biography.plain_text:
Grand Isle Marina shows the practical scale of Randall F. "Randy" Postma’s career. The Michigan waterfront complex grew from a venture that joined his parents and their sons. As president of Dry Land Marina’s Florida arm, he paired management with engineering work. A patent issued in 1978 covered his system for installing precast concrete docks for larger pleasure craft more economically and with fewer pilings.

Performance-boat construction added another strand through Cary Marine. Once the family’s marina business had been sold, Postma concentrated more of his activity in South Florida. A succession of registered marine companies used both Randall F. Postma and the familiar Randy name. He now works from Miami in marina development and commercial charter operations.
